answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity to a stake-backed attestation graph. New agents deposit collateral as solid as basalt before earning reputation; attestations then accrue from existing peers, so every trust vertex traces a paid path. An attacker fabricating identities must fund each one, wait for genuine attestation, and protocol violations slash deposits. Fake clusters become as disposable as quartz dust, yet scaling them costs real capital: the bill grows linearly per identity while an honest agent amortizes one stake over a lifetime.
